entry.title: About
entry.content:
About Me

I am a first year CS Ph.D. student at ECSE of Case Western Reserve University, supervised by Prof. Gourav Datta.

Previously, I was a Ph.D. student at University of California, Merced, supervised by Prof. Meng Tang.
I received my M.S. degree in Electrical Engineering at University of Southern California, working with EESSC, supervised by Prof. Peter A. Beerel and Dr. Gourav Datta. I am extremely grateful for their guidance and help, especially during the tough time in my life.
I received my B.E. degree in Digital Media Technology at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, supervised by Prof. Chenqiang Gao. I was deeply influenced by Professor Gao who led me onto the path of research.

My research interests are computer vision and efficient deep learning. More specifically,

  • Generative Vision-Language Models
  • Efficient Deep Learning
  • Infrared Image Processing

Latest News

  • 2026/06/27: One paper accepted to ECCV 2026.
  • 2025/04/25: One paper accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR).
  • 2023/12/19: One paper accepted to AAAI Edge Intelligence workshop 2024.
  • 2023/10/26: One paper accepted to IEEE Transactions on Image Processing (TIP).
  • 2021/10/31: Best Masters Poster Award of the 11th Annual Research Festival by USC Ming Hsieh Institute.
